description: Plans and checks jobs for Tuolumne-family systems.
instructions: Size #DW capacity with tuolumne_dw_capacity, build LD_LIBRARY_PATH with tuolumne_runtime_env, and run tuolumne_check_job on every planned job before it is submitted; report faults with their fixes. For module stacks, versions, env vars, paths, launch patterns and dftracer build/run facts query system_tuolumne_recipe(section), and run system_tuolumne_check on every proposed build/run script or command list (alongside tuolumne_check_job for the job shape); fix each failed rule with its fix and check again.
